finalText:
All 625 tests pass now, exit code 0.

The bug: `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js:39-43` computed tax on the pre-discount amount (`cents * taxRate`) instead of the discounted amount. The spec (and `cases.js`) require tax to apply after the discount. It only broke cases with a non-zero discount *and* non-zero tax rate simultaneously, which is why 3 of 66 "order totals" cases failed while everything else passed. Fixed by taxing `discounted` instead of `cents`.
